t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes are always in the same coloured pairs. There is a bright forest and a darker forest. Task is to remember which gnomes lead to forests with most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: There are 4 pairs of gnomes. Each colour has another coloured gnome that it is always paired with. Each choice leads to a forest with either a red or yellow basket. Your job is to spot the pattern and collect the most mushrooms.
